::: {.minipage data-latex="{\textwidth}"}
### `SortTextFile` {-}

Creates a new file from a text file, with its lines sorted (case insensitively).

#### Syntax {-}

``` {.lua}
boolean SortTextFile(string inputFile,
                     string outputFile)
```


#### Return value {-}

Type: `boolean`

#### Parameters {-}

**Parameter** | **Description**
| :-- | :-- |
| `string` inputFile | The input file to be sorted. | 
| `string` outputFile | Where to save the sorted file. |


:::
